description: Every position recorded for an aircraft from from to to, both inclusive, oldest first; nothing is cut. The window may span at most 6 hours and must start within the last 90 days; a longer or older window is refused, so read a longer stretch window by window. GADUIN reads every aircraft's position once every 90 seconds and keeps a point only when the reported position time moved, so points are typically 90 seconds apart, with gaps where no receiver heard the aircraft; aircraft of flights GADUIN follows are read every 5 seconds for about 40 minutes either side of their scheduled arrival, so their points are denser there. Nothing is thinned. Positions are what the aircraft's own transponder broadcast, picked up by ground receivers and relayed to GADUIN with a delay, so reported_at_utc, not the time of the request, is when the aircraft was there; where no receiver hears the aircraft (over oceans and remote land) there is no position for that stretch.

from.description: Start of the window: an ISO-8601 time with a UTC offset, e.g. 2026-11-13T12:00:00Z; within the last 90 days.

icao24.description: The aircraft's ICAO 24-bit address as six hex digits, e.g. 4ca7b2 (get_flight_status reports it under aircraft).

to.description: End of the window, after from and at most 6 hours later, in the same form.

name: get_aircraft_track
title: Aircraft recorded track
